title: Structure of the Anticanonical Minimal Model Program for Potentially klt Pairs
summary: We give an alternative proof of the existence of the anticanonical minimal model program for potentially klt pairs, assuming the anticanonical divisor admits a birational Zariski decomposition. Moreover, we establish a structure theorem showing that any partial anticanonical MMP starting from a potentially klt pair can be lifted to a compatible sequence of nonpositive maps between the $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial terminalizations of its successive steps.
